title: Ibushi’s quest to become God
summary: Kota Ibushi’s pursuit of the promotion’s summit reaches a two-night test. After losing his title-shot certificate to Jay White, he receives Naito’s invitation and must beat both men to leave the Dome as champion.

chapters.title: Ibushi finally wins the double championship
chapters.result: Ibushi defeats Naito for both titles.
chapters.context: The Golden Star realizes his long pursuit, but White’s waiting challenge prevents him from treating the victory as the end of the journey.

chapters.title: White cannot steal the coronation
chapters.result: Ibushi defeats White to retain both championships.
chapters.context: Surviving the fresh challenger on the second night completes the defining championship breakthrough of Ibushi’s New Japan run.
